events.verdict: Vincent (LAL) holds Kuminga's (GSW) arm as he receives the pass.
Christie (LAL) rises up into Schroder's (GSW) arm while it is in a mostly vertical position and the contact is marginal.
Green (GSW) briefly places an arm on Reaves' (LAL) back and as Reaves leans into him, the contact with his head/face is marginal.
Reaves (LAL) is retreating in a legal guarding position in Wiggins' (GSW) path and the body contact is incidental. He lowers his arms somewhat, but any contact with Wiggins' arm is marginal.
Schroder (GSW) places a hand on Reaves' (LAL) body and the contact is marginal.
Wiggins (GSW) legally contests Reaves' (LAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Green (GSW) jumps in the air and initiates illegal contact to Reaves' (LAL) body.
Curry (GSW) commits a take foul on Christie (LAL).
Green (GSW) establishes himself in Christie's (LAL) path and does not deliver contact as he sets the pick on the perimeter.
Hachimura (LAL) deflects Green's (GSW) pass and the ball goes out of bounds.
James (LAL) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Schroder (GSW) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
Green (GSW) briefly engages with Reaves (LAL) before establishing himself in a screening position in his path.
Christie (LAL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
James (LAL) and Green (GSW) briefly engage before separating on the perimeter.
Wiggins (GSW) moves alongside Reaves' (LAL) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
